description: Full-stack telemetry for Cloud Yatra, end to end: live service pulse, Cloudflare Worker + D1 backend health (metrics, logs, traces), browser real-user monitoring, game performance, gameplay analytics, and the shared leaderboard. Frontend via Faro; backend via Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo; database via Infinity.

title: Cloud Yatra · Grand Observatory

options.content:
🏔️
Cloud Yatra · Grand Observatory
Live telemetry from Yatri's climb through Himal Rajya, browser → Faro · Worker → Prometheus / Loki / Tempo · D1 → Infinity. Play at cloud-yatra.pages.dev; your run appears below.
🟢 healthy  🟡 strained  🔴 chaos / danger

panels.title: BACKEND LOGS & TRACES · structured logs and request traces
Live backend logs
panels.description: One structured JSON log per request from the Worker, shipped to Loki. Each line carries a correlationId, route, status, and duration.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: Backend log lines per interval by severity. Rising warn and error bars are the first sign the backend is under stress.

panels.title: Error & warning log rate
panels.description: Rate of warn- and error-level backend logs. Pairs with the 5xx panel: the metric shows that errors happened, the logs show which requests and why.

panels.title: Recent request traces (Tempo)
panels.description: Per-request spans shipped to Tempo from the Worker. Open a row to see the full trace.

panels.title: Trace span rate by status
panels.description: Request-span throughput from Tempo, split by span status. Mirrors backend request rate and confirms traces are arriving.

panels.title: Web Vitals · LCP / INP (p95)
panels.description: Real-user loading and interaction latency from Faro web vitals.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {kind="measurement", app_id="$faro_app_id"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_lcp .lcp }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval])
quantile_over_time(0.95, {kind="measurement", app_id="$faro_app_id"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_inp .inp }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval])

panels.title: Web Vitals · CLS / TTFB / FCP
panels.description: Layout stability and first-byte / first-paint timing (Faro).

targets.expr: avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="$faro_app_id"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_cls .cls }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval])
avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="$faro_app_id"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_ttfb .ttfb }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval])
avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="$faro_app_id"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | label_format vital="{{ or .value_fcp .fcp }}" | unwrap vital [$__interval])

panels.title: FPS distribution (heatmap)
panels.description: FPS distribution across all players and devices.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="$faro_app_id"} | logfmt | type="game_client_perf" | unwrap value_fps [$__interval])
